backtest_protocol.execution_model: Allowance and receivables are read as raw SEC Companyfacts balance-sheet INSTANT facts and matched to annual revenue ending the same fiscal-year date; all fields are known only by filed date <= signal date. The rule requires allowance/receivables burden to fall year over year while revenue is non-declining and receivables do not greatly outgrow revenue. Price confirmation uses only signal-date OHLCV. Paper entry is the next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

runtime_fields: raw SEC companyfacts allowance for doubtful accounts instant facts
raw SEC companyfacts annual receivables instant facts
raw SEC companyfacts annual revenue facts
raw SEC companyfacts filed date and period end

2_history_check.exp-20260528-019: Rejected working-capital support scalar inside FGRS. This run is a standalone candidate-pool source using raw allowance burden, not a support scalar.
2_history_check.exp-20260616-018: Rejected inventory-to-revenue leanness. This run exits inventory and tests credit/collection quality.
2_history_check.exp-20260616-021: Rejected raw annual receivables DSO improvement. Its closeout explicitly listed allowance/write-off normalization as materially different PIT collection-quality evidence required for a valid retry. This run tests that different evidence, not a DSO threshold.
2_history_check.exp-20260616-022: Rejected quarterly inventory DIO. It reinforces the need to avoid working-capital threshold sweeps without new evidence.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and accepted compression/distribution candidate-pool comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: exp-20260616-021 rejected raw annual DSO but explicitly required materially different collection-quality evidence such as allowance or write-off normalization. The raw Companyfacts coverage check found broad allowance tag availability, but the economic interpretation is low-confidence because falling reserves can also mean under-reserving.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing raw SEC allowance, receivables, or annual revenue facts; missing matching fiscal-year ends; stale facts; missing CIK mapping; missing OHLCV; missing next open; or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same raw SEC allowance, receivables, and revenue filed-date PIT mapping, allowance-burden improvement gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
